environment.description: Terraform provider runs on a shared CI/CD runner (GitLab Runner, shell executor) with multiple concurrent jobs. The runner uses a shared /tmp directory with no per-job isolation. Other jobs from different teams execute on the same host. No filesystem namespace isolation is configured. The runner operates as a non-root user but /tmp is world-readable. CloudFront distribution origin (S3) has an Origin Access Identity but the bucket policy also allows direct s3:GetObject for the CI role, meaning leaked signing keys allow generating valid signed URLs AND the origin can be accessed directly.
